title: Discrete modules with continuous group action form an abelian category with enough injectives
statement: Let $G$ be a profinite group and $A$ a finite ring. Let $\mathcal C$ have as objects left $A$-modules $M$ with an action of $G$ by $A$-linear automorphisms for which the stabilizer of every $m\in M$ is open, and as morphisms the $A$-linear $G$-equivariant maps. Then $\mathcal C$ is an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Kernels and cokernels are the corresponding $A$-module kernels and cokernels with their induced $G$-actions; a sequence in $\mathcal C$ is exact precisely when its underlying sequence of $A$-modules is exact.
